title: Presbyterian Church in America v. Warrior Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC found acceptable Warrior Presbytery’s approved responses to the exceptions of substance for which the 39th General Assembly had cited it.
first_summary: Warrior Presbytery was cited for failing to respond to exceptions of substance in its minutes. The SJC found its later, Presbytery-approved responses acceptable. No additional rationale appears.
summary: The 39th General Assembly cited Warrior Presbytery under BCO 40 provisions for failing to answer exceptions of substance in several meeting minutes. The SJC recorded that the Presbytery had since submitted responses approved by the Presbytery and found them acceptable. The adopted ruling provides no further rationale or separate relief.

sources.supports: Case identity, GA citation, Presbytery responses, SJC acceptance, vote, and disqualifications.

evidence_notes.identity_and_adoption: The heading identifies Case 2011-07 and the parties; the stated ruling was adopted (printed p. 561, lines 13–17, 21).
evidence_notes.dispute: The 39th GA cited Warrior Presbytery under RAO 16-4(e) and BCO 40-1, 40-4, and 40-5 for failing to respond to exceptions of substance (printed p. 561, line 17).
evidence_notes.outcomes_and_reasons: The SJC noted that Presbytery-approved responses had been submitted and found them acceptable; no further reason or relief is stated (printed p. 561, line 17).
evidence_notes.qualifications: The vote was 19 concurring, two not qualified, and three absent; the two disqualification grounds are stated (printed pp. 561–562, lines 21–33).
evidence_notes.incorporated_decisions: No decision is incorporated by reference; the ruling only cites the earlier GA action and minutes references (printed p. 561, line 17).

source_limits: The source is a brief adopted ruling and does not reproduce the exceptions or Presbytery’s responses. Its roll-call caption incorrectly says Case 2010-18.

score_reasons.concrete_dispute: Identifies the failure to answer exceptions of substance.
score_reasons.decision: States the SJC’s acceptance of the submitted responses without converting it into an unsupported disposition code.
score_reasons.decisive_reason: Faithfully reports the submitted, Presbytery-approved responses and notes the absence of further explanation.
score_reasons.distinctive_value: Shows that the ruling concerns compliance with a BCO 40 citation rather than adjudication of the underlying exceptions.
score_reasons.fidelity: Distinguishes the General Assembly’s citation from the SJC’s adopted finding.
score_reasons.economy: Retains only facts needed to understand the citation and outcome.

verification_notes: Rechecked the citing actor, statutory basis, accepted responses, absence of additional relief, and voting qualifications. The final summary specifies that the 39th General Assembly—not the SJC—issued the citation and does not rely on the erroneous roll-call case number.
repair_notes: The roll-call caption at line 19 identifies Case 2010-18, although the heading and adopted text identify Case 2011-07; the caption should be corrected or annotated.
